strict_reference_gate: All reference/alternative helper, provider and client units pass with exit 0 and no warnings.
negative_gate: Ordinary failures have the predicted proof category; hidden calls fail name resolution; retain unexpected outcomes without relabeling.
only_file_repair_controls: Resolve control-aliases.json only after the canonical source-matched evidence is reviewed; no independent-trial claim.
execution_policy: Root may stage once on a live-confirmed nonpreemptible compute partition; no requeue/automatic retries, no verifier on login/Mac.
raw_evidence: Exact submitted sources, stdout/stderr/CSV bytes and base64, source/stream hashes, tool-version outputs, one-attempt status, Slurm accounting.
